steps: Filled series should omit every 5th letter (D,I,N,S,X)
ABC_FG needs E; then H, L, R, W
Series ABCEFGHJKLMOPQRTUVWY omits D,I,N,S,X
check_code:
import string
tmpl="ABC_FG_JK_MOPQ_TUV_Y"
opts={"A":"DHLRW","B":"DHLSX","C":"EHLRX","D":"EHLRW"}
def fits(o):
    it=iter(o); s="".join(next(it) if ch=="_" else ch for ch in tmpl)
    exp="".join(c for i,c in enumerate(string.ascii_uppercase[:25]) if (i+1)%5!=4)
    return s==exp
good=[k for k,v in opts.items() if fits(v)]
assert good==["D"]

steps: All G are B, so some B are G (I follows)
Some B are J and all J are S, so some S are B (II follows)
check_code:
from itertools import product
# regions: each element type = membership tuple (G,B,J,S); enumerate which types are nonempty
types=list(product([0,1],repeat=4))
ok1=ok2=True; n=0
for mask in range(1<<16):
    ex=[types[i] for i in range(16) if mask>>i&1]
    if any(g and not b for g,b,j,s in ex): continue
    if any(j and not s for g,b,j,s in ex): continue
    if not any(b and j for g,b,j,s in ex): continue
    if not any(g for g,b,j,s in ex): continue  # grapes exist (existential import)
    n+=1
    if not any(b and g for g,b,j,s in ex): ok1=False
    if not any(s and b for g,b,j,s in ex): ok2=False
assert n>0
ans={(1,0):"A",(0,1):"B",(1,1):"C",(0,0):"D"}[(ok1,ok2)]
assert ans=="C"
for k in "ABD": assert ans!=k

method: Dice: common face and cyclic order
steps: Common face 3 in both views
Around 3 (clockwise from top): 5,6 in view 1 and 2,7 in view 2
Four faces around 3 cycle as 5,6,2,7; 9 is opposite 3
5 is opposite 2
check_code:
# cycle of faces around face 3 (top->right order). views give consecutive pairs (5,6) and (2,7)
from itertools import permutations
others=[5,6,2,7]
res=set()
for p in permutations(others):
    if p[0]!=5: continue
    cyc=list(p)
    def consec(a,b): i=cyc.index(a); return cyc[(i+1)%4]==b
    if consec(5,6) and consec(2,7):
        res.add(cyc[2])
assert res=={2}
ans=res.pop()
opts={"A":2,"B":9,"C":3,"D":6}
assert ans==opts["A"]
for k in "BCD": assert ans!=opts[k]

def nxt(n):

    return r*r

odd=[k for k,(a,b) in opts.items() if nxt(a)!=b]
